evidence_method: Read live DigitalOcean Control Panel overview/settings; opened health/advanced forms to read effective fields and cancelled without saving. No API response or synthetic balancing benchmark is claimed.

distribution.scope: Algorithm behavior is established by current provider documentation; actual health/affinity values below were read from this load balancer. No provider-internal implementation name or exact equal request split is claimed.

interpretation_limits: Two failed or successful probes define state transitions, not a guaranteed exactly-ten-second failover time. Probe scheduling, timeout, in-flight traffic and dependency recovery affect observed interruption.
Sticky sessions off does not require consecutive requests or reused connections to hit different backends.
This inspection does not retest data-plane load distribution or change application/infrastructure settings.
